title: Eight-week dumbbell base with walks
summary: 3 strength sessions a week of about 40 minutes and 4 walks of 30 minutes for 8 weeks.
rationale: Frequency and weekly volume follow the evidence for this level (E1, E2), with gradual progression and a planned deload (E3). Walks sit on the days between strength sessions.

blocks.name: Block 1
blocks.rationale: Progress load or effort across weeks, then recover before the next block (E3).
